explanation: Bagheera is the panther, Shere Khan the tiger and Kaa the python. It was the last animated feature Walt Disney oversaw; he died in 1966, before its release.

claims.text: In The Jungle Book (1967), Baloo is a bear.
Bagheera is a panther, Shere Khan is a tiger and Kaa is a python.
The Jungle Book was the last animated feature made under Walt Disney's personal supervision.
Walt Disney died in December 1966, before The Jungle Book was released in 1967.

writerNotes: Self-check 9.3. Lint: clean. Claims: every claim listed, risk at or above the C26 floor and raised where a detail is easy to get wrong; the schema's riskReason list has no 'only' or 'counterintuitive', so such claims carry the nearest listed reason. Datasets: no pinned dataset covers film or TV facts, so every high-risk claim here needs checker evidence from the web. Rival test: The three distractors are the film's other main animals, so a player who half remembers the cast can still slip; Baloo is the bear in Kipling's stories too. Volatility: evergreen; no time words; nothing depends on events after mid-2026. Regional: Kipling's Indian jungle, in a film shown worldwide; no local knowledge is needed. Style: Oxford spelling, straight single quotes, plain hyphens, explanation of 28 words. Myths: claims screened against myths.json; no claim resembles a listed myth. Mystery and encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: c3 is a 'last' claim, so it is marked high; it is the standard account of the film's history.
